POSE 1: ISSUE - Unnatural limb angles, poor balance.
POSE 2: OK - Stable base, neutral spine.
POSE 3: ISSUE - Broken neck, limbs clipping ground.
POSE 4: OK - Good posture, balanced stance.
POSE 5: ISSUE - Floating limbs, awkward sitting position.
POSE 6: ISSUE - Crossed legs, off-center balance.
